name: Slash Split
description: A bright blade stroke slashes diagonally across the first clip with a flash, then the two cut halves slip along the cut in opposite directions and fly off the frame, casting soft shadows on the second clip beneath. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: angle
params.description: Angle of the cut against the horizontal, in degrees (counterclockwise)

params.name: separation
params.description: How far the halves move apart across the cut as they slide, relative to the frame height

params.name: flash
params.description: Color of the blade stroke and its flash (alpha: intensity)

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the shadow cast on the second clip (alpha: strength)
